_doc: Platinum's speakers (data/pearl_speakers.json's rows by Platinum's own line numbers and objects; b2tools/pearl_story.py reads this file in a Platinum build: version.data_path). {zone name: {line of the zone's bank: object local id, or "sys" for a narration line (the plain window)}}. Pearl's rows were moved to the same lines by their words and checked against Platinum's scripts (pokeplatinum res/field/scripts), objects by Platinum's events. The rest (2026-11-02, the dialogue step, found by b2tools/text_check.py --speakers): lines in a talk script after the talked-to person or thing was removed (RemoveObject: Black 2's balloon has nobody to point at), and lines that name another speaker. MAP_ROUTE_201: Platinum's starter scene runs in the briefcase's talk script after the briefcase goes: the rival (2), Rowan (5) and the counterpart (6) speak. MAP_VALOR_LAKEFRONT: the grunt's talk script goes on after he runs off: Cynthia (0) and the rival (10). MAP_VEILSTONE: after the tag battle Looker (26) comes in the counterpart's talk script (29, 32, 35), and again in the storage-key grunt's after the grunt leaves (38-40). MAP_SNOWPOINT: Cynthia (10) comes in the ship sailor's talk script. MAP_ROUTE_213: Looker (33) after the grunt leaves. MAP_ROUTE_212_POKEMON_MANSION_EAST_ROOM: the butler (2) in Mr. Backlot's talk script. MAP_VEILSTONE_GALACTIC_HEADQUARTERS_4F_BACK: Saturn (0) in Charon's. MAP_ETERNA_GALACTIC_BUILDING_1F: the wall to Rotom's room is a thing, and it goes: the plain window. Looker (Veilstone 26, Route 213 33) has no sprite here yet (step 6): until his person is installed, pearl_story shows his lines in the plain window, with Platinum's "Looker:" in front (Black 2's ActorMsg would skip a line for a missing person). MAP_RESORT_AREA_SOUTHWEST_HOUSE (the Villa) 89-91: one line holds both Flint and Volkner ("Flint: ...\nVolkner: ..."), so the plain window, as Platinum shows it in one box.
